sections.title: 2. Our Services
content: FullStack Master provides professional interview coaching services for senior technology professionals, including but not limited to:
items: One-on-one mock interview sessions (behavioral, system design, technical)
Resume and LinkedIn profile review
Career strategy and job search coaching
Executive communication coaching
Leadership and soft skills development
Educational content via courses and articles

Confirmation emails are sent within 24 hours of booking
